items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had Snooky, Snooky Young, Ernie Royal, Bill Berry, Tony Studd, Frank Wess, Jerome Richardson, Jimmy Hamilton. Who else? Oh, Milt Hinton, Hank Jones. It was a good band.

ctx.x: Because we had -- well, he got guys like Louis Bellson and Joey Benjamin and Bill Berry and -- who else? On the plane Duke says, "I'm going to give you Russell Procope and I'll go and get Hilton Jefferson for the road band."
